meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加新通道或修改行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在定制 NanoClaw 的行为或集成新通道。
copy.tagline_en: Add new channels or modify NanoClaw behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are customizing NanoClaw's behavior or integrating new channels.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude会充当NanoClaw的定制向导。它会主动提问，了解你想修改或添加哪些功能（如新增频道、调整触发规则、添加MCP集成、更改助手行为等），并指导你通过命令或编辑文件完成变更。
howto.when: 当你想要修改NanoClaw的行为或添加新功能时触发。典型场景：添加Telegram/Slack等频道、更改触发规则、添加集成、修改路由器。用户表达这类需求后技能启动。

say.note: Claude会询问频道细节并引导安装。

say.text: 我想修改一个助手组的性格指令。

say.note: Claude会检查是否存在对应安装技能。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude becomes a customization guide for NanoClaw. It proactively asks questions to understand what you want to modify or add (e.g., new channels, trigger rules, MCP integrations, assistant behavior), then guides you through commands or file edits to make the change.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to modify NanoClaw's behavior or add new capabilities. Typical scenarios: adding Telegram/Slack channels, changing triggers, adding integrations, modifying the router. The skill activates upon such requests.

say_en.text: Help me add Telegram channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude asks details and guides installation.

say_en.text: I want to change the personality instructions of an agent group.
say_en.note: Claude guides editing the CLAUDE.md file.
Claude checks if an existing install skill applies.
